admin.required_off: Two-step sign-in is no longer required

email.title: Confirm Your New Email
email.explain: Enter your password to confirm it. Until then, password resets go to your previous email, and single sign-on doesn't link to your account by this one.
email.explain_sso: Confirm it within 15 minutes of signing in. Until then, password resets go to your previous email, and single sign-on doesn't link to your account by this one. If it's been longer, sign out and sign in again first.

plain_http.warning_body: This server uses plain HTTP, so the connection isn't encrypted. Anyone on the same network can read and change what's sent, including your password.
plain_http.warning_advice: Use it only on your home network or over a VPN.
plain_http.warning_stored: Until you connect, nothing syncs with this server, and the app keeps working with what's on this phone. It asks again the next time it opens.
plain_http.refused_body: This server uses plain HTTP and isn't on your own network, so the app won't connect to it. Plain HTTP works only with a server at a private address, such as 192.168.1.20, or a local name, such as cooktrace.local. Anywhere else, use HTTPS.
plain_http.refused_stored: Nothing syncs with this server, and the app keeps working with what's on this phone. To switch to an HTTPS address, disconnect in Settings > Server Connection and connect again.
plain_http.refused_short: Plain HTTP works only with a server on your own network. Use an https:// address for this server.
plain_http.unreachable: Couldn't reach {url}. Check the address, and that this phone is on the same network or VPN as the server.
plain_http.invalid_address: Enter an address that starts with http:// or https://, such as https://cooktrace.example.com.
plain_http.blocked: Plain HTTP to {origin} isn't allowed. Use an https:// address, or a server on your own network.

server_signin.web_page: Something other than CookTrace answered with a web page: often a sign-in proxy (Authentik, Authelia, Cloudflare Access), or this isn't your server's address. Let the app reach /api on your server.
server_signin.options_failed: Couldn't load this server's sign-in options. Retry, or sign in with your password if the server allows it.
server_signin.token_refused: This sign-in couldn't be checked, so it was stopped. Update your CookTrace server, or connect with your password.
server_signin.unreachable: Can't reach your server right now. Check that it's running, then Retry.
server_signin.proxy_sign_in: Something in front of your server is asking you to sign in. Sign in there, then reload this page.
server_signin.server_error: Your server answered with an error. Try again in a moment.
